The '''Tocoya system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tocoya]].
